world.title: Khamenei ties US-Iran peace deal to Israel ending attacks on Lebanon
world.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei stated that a peace agreement between Iran and the United States is dependent on Israel ceasing its attacks on Lebanon. He called for an "absolute, unconditional termination" of such actions in a post on X on Sunday. Khamenei's remarks highlight the interconnectedness of regional conflicts and diplomatic relations in the Middle East.

world.title: 'Crimes against humanity' complaints filed against Bangladesh ex-president
world.summary: Complaints alleging "crimes against humanity" have been filed against former Bangladesh President Mohammed Shahabuddin with the Bangladesh International Crimes Tribunal. This action follows his recent resignation from the presidency. The specific details of the allegations have not been disclosed, but the filing reflects ongoing scrutiny of political figures in Bangladesh regarding past actions during periods of conflict.

world.title: No path forward except jihad and resistance, Mojtaba Khamenei tells Hezbollah
world.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei expressed unwavering support for Hezbollah, stating there is “no path forward except jihad and resistance.” He emphasized that defending Hezbollah is a strategic mandate for Tehran and called for the “absolute, unconditional termination” of Israeli aggression against Lebanon. Khamenei's remarks underline Iran's commitment to the group amid ongoing regional tensions.

business.title: CXMT shares make Shanghai debut after Asia’s biggest IPO of 2026
business.summary: Chinese DRAM chipmaker CXMT has made its debut on the Shanghai stock exchange following Asia's largest IPO of 2026, raising $8.6 billion. The company enters the market with a valuation of $85.5 billion. With a low free float of 6.73%, trading activity is expected to be amplified as investors engage with the newly listed shares.

business.title: How MRF’s 102-member promoter family has stayed united for 80 years
business.summary: MRF, India's largest tyre manufacturer, revealed in its annual report that its 102-member promoter family holds 27.77% of the company. Thirteen promoter entities own approximately 16%, while individual family members collectively possess nearly 12%. The company avoids media interactions, and several investors and former directors declined to comment, with some agreeing to speak only anonymously.

business.title: More Indian EVs head to distant shores as Maruti, Tata, M&M drive 14-fold export surge
business.summary: Indian electric vehicle exports surged to 15,641 units in the three months ending June, a significant increase from 1,122 units during the same period last year, according to industry data. This growth represents over half of the total 28,652 units exported in the previous fiscal year, driven by manufacturers such as Maruti, Tata, and Mahindra & Mahindra.

technology.title: US-Iran war news: Tehran signals it will pause attacks if America does the same; Trump shares AI images of Kharg strike, bombing of Iranian vessels - 10 KEY developments
technology.summary: The United States has paused airstrikes on Iran, indicating a potential shift towards diplomacy to prevent a broader regional conflict. Tehran has signaled it may also halt attacks if the U.S. does the same. Mediators emphasize that diplomacy is the only viable solution to the ongoing crisis, which has escalated over the past two weeks.

technology.title: Palworld 1.0 surges to nearly 1 Million concurrent Steam players as sales Top 30 Million copies
technology.summary: Palworld's 1.0 launch achieved nearly one million concurrent players on Steam and sold approximately 1.8 million copies within the first 10 days. Total sales have exceeded 30 million, generating nearly $700 million in revenue. The game maintains a 93% positive rating on Steam, following its successful early access debut in early 2024.

technology.title: Claude AI Shared Chats Reportedly Exposed in Google Search Results
technology.summary: Anthropic’s Claude AI shared links were reportedly exposed in Google search results, leading to privacy concerns for users who shared sensitive conversations. A Reddit post highlighted that hundreds of these chats became publicly discoverable, prompting discussions about the implications for user confidentiality. The incident raises questions about data security and the management of shared content in AI platforms.

sports.title: Bavarian Football Works
sports.summary: A recent controversy arose over accusations of "fake news" regarding a supposed Manchester City bid, which was never reported. The discussion intensified after a critique of a report on Klopp, deemed ridiculous and disrespectful to professional journalists. The situation has sparked debate on whether to allow ongoing disputes or intervene to prevent further conflict within the football community.

sports.title: Soumya recalled for Darwin Test after five-year absence
sports.summary: Bangladesh has announced a 15-player squad for their first Test in Australia in 23 years, with nearly half the team set to experience top-flight cricket in the country for the first time. Veteran batter Soumya Sarkar has been recalled after a five-year absence, filling the gap left by three injured first-choice players ahead of the Darwin Test.

sports.title: Commonwealth Games: Jadumani wins high-octane India-Pakistan bout, Preeti one win away from medal
sports.summary: Jadumani Singh defeated Pakistan's Sumama Rehman in a competitive bout at the Commonwealth Games boxing competition in Glasgow. Meanwhile, Preeti Pawar advanced to the quarterfinals, positioning herself one win away from securing her first Commonwealth Games medal. Both athletes showcased strong performances, contributing to India's presence in the tournament as they aim for further success.

health.title: How the brain rewires for motherhood
health.summary: Motherhood triggers significant changes in the brain, enhancing parental instincts that operate subconsciously. New mothers often feel compelled to check on their sleeping infants, remain nearby, and respond quickly to their cries. This transition also leads to a profound shift in priorities, as highlighted by the late British psychotherapist Naomi Stadlen, who noted the relentless nature of motherhood.

health.title: Researchers identify eight new genes linked to schizophrenia
health.summary: Researchers in the United Kingdom have identified eight new genes linked to schizophrenia, a complex psychiatric disorder affecting thought, emotion, and behavior. This discovery enhances the understanding of schizophrenia, which can cause symptoms like hallucinations and delusions. The findings may contribute to the development of future treatments for this severe mental health condition, potentially improving patient outcomes.

health.title: Sleep Disorders Don’t Just Exhaust You. New Research Shows They Change Your Brain
health.summary: Research from Florida International University indicates that sleep disorders lead to both shared and unique structural changes in brain systems responsible for attention, decision-making, and emotional regulation. These alterations can significantly impact cognitive functions beyond just causing fatigue. The findings highlight the importance of addressing sleep disorders to mitigate their broader effects on brain health and functionality.

science.title: Fertility and IVF facility relaunched at Manipal Hospital
science.summary: Manipal Hospital Mysuru relaunched its Fertility and IVF Centre on World IVF Day, enhancing its services with upgraded technology and improved infrastructure. The facility now offers a broader range of advanced reproductive treatments. The relaunch event was attended by Rtn. Sam Cherian, Founder-Chairman of Schevaran Laboratories, and DCP (Law and Order) Dr. Harsha Priyamvada.

science.title: From The Hindu Archives, July 27, 1976: ‘Roman letter’ on Mars rock
science.summary: On July 26, 1976, U.S. scientists successfully transmitted commands to Mars, resolving an issue with the Viking lander's soil-sampling arm. The adjustments were made from Pasadena, California. However, another critical experiment involving the seismology probe remained unresponsive, indicating ongoing challenges in the mission. The developments were reported in The Hindu Archives on July 27, 1976.

science.title: Scientists trace the shocking origin of human eyes to an ancient "cyclops": Study
science.summary: Researchers have identified a tiny, one-eyed ancestor from nearly 600 million years ago as a key influence in the evolution of vertebrate eyes, including humans. This ancient organism's median eye is believed to persist in modern species as the pineal gland, which plays a crucial role in regulating sleep patterns in relation to daylight.

entertainment.title: Dhanush on National Awards row; says better films than 'Raayan' existed; 'Some things simply fall into place on their own'
entertainment.summary: Dhanush addressed the controversy surrounding the 72nd National Film Awards, acknowledging criticisms on social media regarding the selection of winners. He noted that many deserving films, including those from Tamil cinema, were overlooked. Dhanush remarked that sometimes, outcomes occur naturally, suggesting that the recognition of "Raayan" may not reflect the overall quality of films released this year.

entertainment.title: ‘The Odyssey’ leaked online: High-quality pirated version garners millions of views before takedown
entertainment.summary: A high-quality pirated version of Christopher Nolan's film 'The Odyssey' leaked online, attracting millions of views before being removed. Despite the piracy, the film has earned nearly USD 700 million at the box office. The unauthorized posting was shared by an anonymous account and was taken down shortly after it gained significant attention on the platform.

entertainment.title: Pisces Horoscope Today: July 27, 2026
entertainment.summary: Pisces individuals are advised to manage their tendency to overthink on July 27, 2026. While they recognize the need to create positive changes in their lives, feelings of hesitation and guilt may hinder their progress. It is essential for Pisces to navigate these emotions effectively to avoid being overwhelmed and to focus on their aspirations.
